content.short: PACT is a decentralized RWA and lending protocol on Aptos and Celo providing institutional-grade on-chain credit.
content.description: PACT is a leading decentralized finance protocol specializing in tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) and automated credit markets. Built natively on Aptos and Celo, the platform manages significant TVL, making it a primary destination for institutional-grade yields. PACT enables users to access decentralized lending and payment services backed by diversified real-world portfolios, bridging the gap between traditional credit and Web3. Through integration with high-performance DEXs, PACT offers yield-bearing pools that inherit the security and transparency of on-chain settlement.
content.meta: PACT provides decentralized RWA lending and on-chain credit infrastructure on Aptos. Discover PACT and other RWA Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
